info.title: RolloutDesk REST API
info.description: Rust/axum feature-release lab. Operator APIs use an opaque HttpOnly cookie plus CSRF and exact Origin on writes. The client API accepts an environment-scoped bearer token and reads published configuration only. Handler responses use no-store; this specification contains no real credentials. Scope: three fixed flags, two environments, one local operator. No create/delete, OAuth, exposure collection or SDK is supplied.

post.summary: Evaluate only published configuration with a scoped bearer token
post.description: A staging token cannot evaluate production and vice versa. No operator cookie, Origin or CSRF is required. Invalid environments fail authentication with 401. Unknown syntactically valid keys and unpublished flags safely return false with HTTP 200. Subjects and decisions are not persisted.

items.description: Case-sensitive ASCII subject. It is not stored by evaluation or preview.

allowlist.description: Canonical responses sort these exact case-sensitive IDs. Duplicate request IDs are invalid.

NullablePublication.description: A full publication object, or null before the first publication. PUBLISH has a null sourceRevision; ROLLBACK references an existing revision.

Decision.description: Unknown valid keys return false, FLAG_NOT_FOUND and null bucket/revision. Unpublished registered keys return false, UNPUBLISHED and a numeric bucket. Draft preview always has null revision.

email.description: At most 254 UTF-8 bytes before normalization. Trimmed and ASCII-lowercased for lookup; no registration endpoint exists.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes. No password value is included in this specification.

note.description: Rust trims surrounding Unicode whitespace, then requires 10 to 500 Unicode scalar values. The untrimmed JSON string can be longer than 500 characters.

cookieSession.name: rolloutdesk_session
cookieSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly cookie from login, expires after 12 hours. Not a JWT. Swagger browser consoles cannot manually set this cookie; use the same-origin UI or Postman cookie jar.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: csrfToken from the matching successful login/session response. Combine with the session cookie and exact Origin.

clientBearer.description: Private token scoped to the requested staging or production environment. This is not an OAuth/JWT token. Never put it in frontend code or a URL.
